events.verdict: Green (GSW) momentarily applies his hand to Williamson's (NOP) upper body, and he immediately removes his hand as Williamson passes the ball.
Podziemski (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position as Williamson (NOP) passes the ball.
Williamson (NOP) establishes his right foot as his pivot, foot, which he maintains prior to releasing the pass.
Santos (GSW) jumps A to B into Bey (NOP) as he defends the shot attempt.
Williamson (NOP) extends his hands into Melton (GSW) and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Moody (GSW) grazes Williamson's (NOP) arm as he starts his drive to the basket.
Green (GSW) maintains verticality as he defends Williamson's (NOP) shot attempt.
After Murray (NOP) deflects the ball, he extends his leg into Melton's (GSW) path, causing Melton to trip and affecting his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Moody (GSW) moves alongside Murray's (NOP) path as he defends the shot attempt.

Murray (NOP) is retreating away from Melton's (GSW) path, and the contact occurs as Melton cuts back towards the basket.  The ensuing contact from McGowens (NOP) occurs after Melton has released his shot attempt and is considered marginal.
Green (GSW) legally contests Bey's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Podziemski (GSW) briefly grasps Williamson's (NOP) arm as they pursue the rebound.
Santos (GSW) and Jones (NOP) come together at the same spot as they pursue the rebound.
McGowens (NOP) directly contests Melton's (GSW) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Melton's (GSW) hand after the release.
Melton (GSW) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pelicans.
Green (GSW) commits a take foul on Jones (NOP).
Podziemski (GSW) commits a take foul on Murray (NOP).
